ST-Standard GM-09 Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound RGB Gaming Headset (50mm Neodymium Drivers / Noise-Cancelling Flexible Mic / Dynamic RGB Lighting / Heavy Duty 2.3m USB Cable / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Elevate your competitive audio awareness and immersion with the ST-Standard GM-09 Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound RGB Gaming Headset, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a comprehensive 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Driven by massive 50mm speaker drivers tuned for precise spatial audio tracking, this headset allows gamers to pinpoint enemy footsteps, gunfire directions, and cinematic sound effects with extreme accuracy. Built with premium soft leather memory foam ear cushions and an adjustable ergonomic headband structure, it minimizes clamping force to ensure long-lasting comfort during marathon gaming sessions. The GM-09 features an unbreakable flexible omnidirectional microphone integrated with active noise-reduction technology to deliver crystal-clear team communication. Outfitted with dynamic RGB ear cup illumination and a durable 2.3-meter braided USB cable, this plug-and-play audio gear offers seamless compatibility across PCs, laptops, and USB-enabled consoles.
